name: PostgreSQL Database Provider
description: Provides PostgreSQL as the Jellyfin database backend via EF Core and Npgsql, including tooling to migrate an existing Jellyfin SQLite database into a PostgreSQL schema.
overview: Use PostgreSQL as Jellyfin's database backend

versions.changelog: v1.1.0.0 — InstantSearch sub-15ms, exportación PG→SQLite nativa, cache de queries en memoria, optimización de índices GIN y navegación, tuning de memoria del servidor, reescritura ORDER BY RANDOM() → TABLESAMPLE.
